The script builds the keep index for each of the three per-layer tensors correctly: for `c_attn.weight` and `c_attn.bias` it keeps, per 768-wide q/k/v segment, all 64-wide head blocks except head 5 (yielding columns 0..319, 384..767, 768..1087, 1152..1535, 1536..1855, 1920..2303 in order), and for `c_proj.weight` it keeps rows 0..319 and 384..767 along axis 0. All other tensors are left untouched with unchanged names and dtypes, the four required shape/count assertions run before `save_file`, and the output is written to `out/T2/model.safetensors` as a single file.
